cmsFields.title: OWASP WSTG review: a method, not a security seal
cmsFields.subtitle: How should a team turn a living security testing guide into a scoped, auditable assessment?
cmsFields.summary: OWASP WSTG repository review of testing scope, versioned scenario references and reporting, distinguishing a living guide from a security certification.
keyTakeaways: This default-branch snapshot is not the stable 4.2 release.
Versioned scenario identifiers make reports more auditable than moving latest links.
The guide is a testing method, not a scanner result or security certification.
